snippet.title: Skigill - 1.0 Trailer
snippet.description:
Skigill is out of Early Access, play Skigill 1.0 on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3657180/Skigill/

Check out the initial trailer for more gameplay: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=s03ZYD22pLY

Music and SFX by Noé Guiton.
Listen to the full OST here: https://youtu.be/_ptQ7gre0E0
